36.tr: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
36.tl: Waimtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoona

36.t: أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
36.c: ألم أعهد إليكم يا بني آدم أن لا تعبدوا الشيطان إنه لكم عدو مبين
36.tr: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
36.tl: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun

36.t: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
36.c: وأن اعبدوني هذا صراط مستقيم
36.tr: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
36.tl: Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratun mustaqeemun

36.t: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
36.c: ولقد أضل منكم جبلا كثيرا أفلم تكونوا تعقلون
36.tr: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
36.tl: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloona

36.t: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
36.c: هذه جهنم التي كنتم توعدون
36.tr: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
36.tl: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum tooAAadoona

36.t: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
36.c: اصلوها اليوم بما كنتم تكفرون
36.tr: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
36.tl: Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroona

36.t: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
36.c: اليوم نختم على أفواههم وتكلمنا أيديهم وتشهد أرجلهم بما كانوا يكسبون
36.tr: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
36.tl: Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboona

36.t: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
36.c: ولو نشاء لطمسنا على أعينهم فاستبقوا الصراط فأنى يبصرون
36.tr: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
36.tl: Walaw nashao latamasna AAala aAAyunihim faistabaqoo alssirata faanna yubsiroona

36.t: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
36.c: ولو نشاء لمسخناهم على مكانتهم فما استطاعوا مضيا ولا يرجعون
36.tr: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
36.tl: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum AAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyan wala yarjiAAoona

36.t: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
36.c: ومن نعمره ننكسه في الخلق أفلا يعقلون
36.tr: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
36.tl: Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala yaAAqiloona

36.t: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
36.c: وما علمناه الشعر وما ينبغي له إن هو إلا ذكر وقرآن مبين
36.tr: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
36.tl: Wama AAallamnahu alshshiAAra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrun waquranun mubeenun

36.t: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
36.c: لينذر من كان حيا ويحق القول على الكافرين
36.tr: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.
36.tl: Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireena

36.t: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
36.c: أولم يروا أنا خلقنا لهم مما عملت أيدينا أنعاما فهم لها مالكون
36.tr: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
36.tl: Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahum laha malikoona

36.t: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
36.c: وذللناها لهم فمنها ركوبهم ومنها يأكلون
36.tr: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
36.tl: Wathallalnaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloona

36.t: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
36.c: ولهم فيها منافع ومشارب أفلا يشكرون
36.tr: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
36.tl: Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibu afala yashkuroona

36.t: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
36.c: واتخذوا من دون الله آلهة لعلهم ينصرون
36.tr: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
36.tl: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan laAAallahum yunsaroona

36.t: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
36.c: لا يستطيعون نصرهم وهم لهم جند محضرون
36.tr: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
36.tl: La yastateeAAoona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroona

36.t: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
36.c: فلا يحزنك قولهم إنا نعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون
36.tr: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
36.tl: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna naAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona

36.t: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
36.c: أولم ير الإنسان أنا خلقناه من نطفة فإذا هو خصيم مبين
36.tr: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
36.tl: Awalam yara alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun

36.t: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
36.c: وضرب لنا مثلا ونسي خلقه قال من يحيي العظام وهي رميم
36.tr: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
36.tl: Wadaraba lana mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithama wahiya rameemun

36.t: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
36.c: قل يحييها الذي أنشأها أول مرة وهو بكل خلق عليم
36.tr: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
36.tl: Qul yuhyeeha allathee anshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleemun

36.t: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
36.c: الذي جعل لكم من الشجر الأخضر نارا فإذا أنتم منه توقدون
36.tr: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
36.tl: Allathee jaAAala lakum mina alshshajari alakhdari naran faitha antum minhu tooqidoona

36.t: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
36.c: أوليس الذي خلق السماوات والأرض بقادر على أن يخلق مثلهم بلى وهو الخلاق العليم
36.tr: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
36.tl: Awalaysa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu

36.t: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
36.c: إنما أمره إذا أراد شيئا أن يقول له كن فيكون
36.tr: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
36.tl: Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu

36.t: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
36.c: فسبحان الذي بيده ملكوت كل شيء وإليه ترجعون
36.tr: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
36.tl: Fasubhana allathee biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wailayhi turjaAAoona

37.tr: By those [angels] lined up in rows
And those who drive [the clouds]
And those who recite the message,
Indeed, your God is One,

37.t: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
37.c: رب السماوات والأرض وما بينهما ورب المشارق
37.tr: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
37.tl: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma warabbu almashariqi

37.t: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
37.c: إنا زينا السماء الدنيا بزينة الكواكب
37.tr: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
37.tl: Inna zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bizeenatin alkawakibi

37.tr: And as protection against every rebellious devil

37.t: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
37.c: لا يسمعون إلى الملإ الأعلى ويقذفون من كل جانب
37.tr: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
37.tl: La yassammaAAoona ila almalai alaAAla wayuqthafoona min kulli janibin

37.tr: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

37.t: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
37.c: إلا من خطف الخطفة فأتبعه شهاب ثاقب
37.tr: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
37.tl: Illa man khatifa alkhatfata faatbaAAahu shihabun thaqibun

37.t: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
37.c: فاستفتهم أهم أشد خلقا أم من خلقنا إنا خلقناهم من طين لازب
37.tr: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
37.tl: Faistaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqna inna khalaqnahum min teenin lazibin

37.tr: But you wonder, while they mock,
And when they are reminded, they remember not.
And when they see a sign, they ridicule

37.t: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
37.c: وقالوا إن هذا إلا سحر مبين
37.tr: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
37.tl: Waqaloo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun

37.t: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
37.c: أإذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أإنا لمبعوثون
37.tr: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
37.tl: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona

37.tr: And our forefathers [as well]?"
Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

37.t: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
37.c: فإنما هي زجرة واحدة فإذا هم ينظرون
37.tr: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
37.tl: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun faitha hum yanthuroona

37.c: وقالوا يا ويلنا هذا يوم الدين
37.tr: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
37.tl: Waqaloo ya waylana hatha yawmu alddeeni

37.t: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
37.c: هذا يوم الفصل الذي كنتم به تكذبون
37.tr: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
37.tl: Hatha yawmu alfasli allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

37.t: ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
37.c: احشروا الذين ظلموا وأزواجهم وما كانوا يعبدون
37.tr: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
37.tl: Ohshuroo allatheena thalamoo waazwajahum wama kanoo yaAAbudoona

37.t: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
37.c: من دون الله فاهدوهم إلى صراط الجحيم
37.tr: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
37.tl: Min dooni Allahi faihdoohum ila sirati aljaheemi

37.tr: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
[They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
But they, that Day, are in surrender.
And they will approach one another blaming each other.

37.t: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
37.c: قالوا إنكم كنتم تأتوننا عن اليمين
37.tr: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
37.tl: Qaloo innakum kuntum tatoonana AAani alyameeni

37.tr: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

37.t: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
37.c: وما كان لنا عليكم من سلطان بل كنتم قوما طاغين
37.tr: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
37.tl: Wama kana lana AAalaykum min sultanin bal kuntum qawman tagheena

37.t: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
37.c: فحق علينا قول ربنا إنا لذائقون
37.tr: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
37.tl: Fahaqqa AAalayna qawlu rabbina inna lathaiqoona

37.tr: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

37.t: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
37.c: إنهم كانوا إذا قيل لهم لا إله إلا الله يستكبرون
37.tr: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
37.tl: Innahum kanoo itha qeela lahum la ilaha illa Allahu yastakbiroona

37.t: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
37.c: ويقولون أئنا لتاركو آلهتنا لشاعر مجنون
37.tr: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
37.tl: Wayaqooloona ainna latarikoo alihatina lishaAAirin majnoonin

37.tr: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,

37.t: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
37.c: وما تجزون إلا ما كنتم تعملون
37.tr: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
37.tl: Wama tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona

37.tr: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
Those will have a provision determined -
Fruits; and they will be honored
In gardens of pleasure
On thrones facing one another.
There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
White and delicious to the drinkers;

37.t: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
37.c: لا فيها غول ولا هم عنها ينزفون
37.tr: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
37.tl: La feeha ghawlun wala hum AAanha yunzafoona

37.tr: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

37.t: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
37.c: قال قائل منهم إني كان لي قرين
37.tr: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
37.tl: Qala qailun minhum innee kana lee qareenun

37.tr: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

37.t: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
37.c: أإذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أإنا لمدينون
37.tr: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
37.tl: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamadeenoona

37.tr: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me.

37.t: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
37.c: ولولا نعمة ربي لكنت من المحضرين
37.tr: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
37.tl: Walawla niAAmatu rabbee lakuntu mina almuhdareena

37.tr: Then, are we not to die

37.t: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
37.c: إلا موتتنا الأولى وما نحن بمعذبين
37.tr: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
37.tl: Illa mawtatana aloola wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena

37.tr: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

37.t: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
37.c: أذلك خير نزلا أم شجرة الزقوم
37.tr: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?
37.tl: Athalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu alzzaqqoomi

37.tr: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

37.t: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
37.c: إنها شجرة تخرج في أصل الجحيم
37.tr: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
37.tl: Innaha shajaratun takhruju fee asli aljaheemi

37.tr: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

37.t: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
37.c: فإنهم لآكلون منها فمالئون منها البطون
37.tr: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
37.tl: Fainnahum laakiloona minha famalioona minha albutoona

37.t: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
37.c: ثم إن لهم عليها لشوبا من حميم
37.tr: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
37.tl: Thumma inna lahum AAalayha lashawban min hameemin

37.tr: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
Indeed they found their fathers astray.
So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
And We had already sent among them warners.
Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
But not the chosen servants of Allah.
And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
"Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
Then We drowned the disbelievers.
And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

37.t: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
37.c: إذ قال لأبيه وقومه ماذا تعبدون
37.tr: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
37.tl: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi matha taAAbudoona

37.tr: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?
Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
And he cast a look at the stars
And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
So they turned away from him, departing.

37.t: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
37.c: فراغ إلى آلهتهم فقال ألا تأكلون
37.tr: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
37.tl: Faragha ila alihatihim faqala ala takuloona

37.tr: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
Then the people came toward him, hastening.
He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
While Allah created you and that which you do?"

37.t: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
37.c: قالوا ابنوا له بنيانا فألقوه في الجحيم
37.tr: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."
37.tl: Qaloo ibnoo lahu bunyanan faalqoohu fee aljaheemi

37.tr: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.

37.t: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
37.c: وقال إني ذاهب إلى ربي سيهدين
37.tr: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
37.tl: Waqala innee thahibun ila rabbee sayahdeeni

37.tr: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

37.t: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
37.c: فلما بلغ معه السعي قال يا بني إني أرى في المنام أني أذبحك فانظر ماذا ترى قال يا أبت افعل ما تؤمر ستجدني إن شاء الله من الصابرين
37.tr: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."
37.tl: Falamma balagha maAAahu alssaAAya qala ya bunayya innee ara fee almanami annee athbahuka faonthur matha tara qala ya abati ifAAal ma tumaru satajidunee in shaa Allahu mina alssabireena

37.tr: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
We called to him, "O Abraham,

37.t: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
37.c: قد صدقت الرؤيا إنا كذلك نجزي المحسنين
37.tr: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
37.tl: Qad saddaqta alrruya inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

37.tr: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
"Peace upon Abraham."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.

37.t: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
37.c: وباركنا عليه وعلى إسحاق ومن ذريتهما محسن وظالم لنفسه مبين
37.tr: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.
37.tl: Wabarakna AAalayhi waAAala ishaqa wamin thurriyyatihima muhsinun wathalimun linafsihi mubeenun

37.tr: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
And We gave them the explicit Scripture,
And We guided them on the straight path.
And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
"Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah?
Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -
Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
Except the chosen servants of Allah.
And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
"Peace upon Elias."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
[So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].
Then We destroyed the others.
And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
And at night. Then will you not use reason?
And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
[Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
And he drew lots and was among the losers.
Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
And had he not been of those who exalt Allah,

37.t: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
37.c: للبث في بطنه إلى يوم يبعثون
37.tr: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
37.tl: Lalabitha fee batnihi ila yawmi yubAAathoona

37.tr: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.

37.t: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
37.c: وأرسلناه إلى مائة ألف أو يزيدون
37.tr: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
37.tl: Waarsalnahu ila miati alfin aw yazeedoona

37.tr: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?

37.t: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
37.c: أم خلقنا الملائكة إناثا وهم شاهدون
37.tr: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
37.tl: Am khalaqna almalaikata inathan wahum shahidoona

37.tr: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
" Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
Has He chosen daughters over sons?
What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
Then will you not be reminded?
Or do you have a clear authority?
Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

37.t: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
37.c: وجعلوا بينه وبين الجنة نسبا ولقد علمت الجنة إنهم لمحضرون
37.tr: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].
37.tl: WajaAAaloo baynahu wabayna aljinnati nasaban walaqad AAalimati aljinnatu innahum lamuhdaroona

37.tr: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].
So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.

37.t: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
37.c: وما منا إلا له مقام معلوم
37.tr: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
37.tl: Wama minna illa lahu maqamun maAAloomun

37.tr: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah."
And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,

37.t: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
37.c: لو أن عندنا ذكرا من الأولين
37.tr: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
37.tl: Law anna AAindana thikran mina alawwaleena

37.tr: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah."
But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
[That] indeed, they would be those given victory
And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
Then for Our punishment are they impatient?

37.t: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
37.c: فإذا نزل بساحتهم فساء صباح المنذرين
37.tr: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
37.tl: Faitha nazala bisahatihim fasaa sabahu almunthareena

37.tr: And leave them for a time.
And see, for they are going to see.

37.t: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
37.c: سبحان ربك رب العزة عما يصفون
37.tr: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
37.tl: Subhana rabbika rabbi alAAizzati AAamma yasifoona

37.tr: And peace upon the messengers.
And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

38.t: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
38.c: ص والقرآن ذي الذكر
38.tr: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...
38.tl: Sad waalqurani thee alththikri

38.t: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
38.c: بل الذين كفروا في عزة وشقاق
38.tr: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
38.tl: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee AAizzatin washiqaqin

38.t: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
38.c: كم أهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن فنادوا ولات حين مناص
38.tr: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
38.tl: Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadaw walata heena manasin

38.t: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
38.c: وعجبوا أن جاءهم منذر منهم وقال الكافرون هذا ساحر كذاب
38.tr: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
38.tl: WaAAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum waqala alkafiroona hatha sahirun kaththabun

38.t: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
38.c: أجعل الآلهة إلها واحدا إن هذا لشيء عجاب
38.tr: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
38.tl: AjaAAala alalihata ilahan wahidan inna hatha lashayon AAujabun

38.t: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
38.c: وانطلق الملأ منهم أن امشوا واصبروا على آلهتكم إن هذا لشيء يراد
38.tr: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
38.tl: Waintalaqa almalao minhum ani imshoo waisbiroo AAala alihatikum inna hatha lashayon yuradu

38.t: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
38.c: ما سمعنا بهذا في الملة الآخرة إن هذا إلا اختلاق
38.tr: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
38.tl: Ma samiAAna bihatha fee almillati alakhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaqun

38.t: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
38.c: أأنزل عليه الذكر من بيننا بل هم في شك من ذكري بل لما يذوقوا عذاب
38.tr: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
38.tl: Aonzila AAalayhi alththikru min baynina bal hum fee shakkin min thikree bal lamma yathooqoo AAathabi

38.t: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
38.c: أم عندهم خزائن رحمة ربك العزيز الوهاب
38.tr: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
38.tl: Am AAindahum khazainu rahmati rabbika alAAazeezi alwahhabi

38.t: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
38.c: أم لهم ملك السماوات والأرض وما بينهما فليرتقوا في الأسباب
38.tr: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
38.tl: Am lahum mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma falyartaqoo fee alasbabi

38.t: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
38.c: جند ما هنالك مهزوم من الأحزاب
38.tr: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
38.tl: Jundun ma hunalika mahzoomun mina alahzabi

38.t: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
38.c: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وفرعون ذو الأوتاد
38.tr: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
38.tl: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wafirAAawnu thoo alawtadi

38.t: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
38.c: وثمود وقوم لوط وأصحاب الأيكة أولئك الأحزاب
38.tr: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.
38.tl: Wathamoodu waqawmu lootin waashabu alaykati olaika alahzabu

38.t: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
38.c: إن كل إلا كذب الرسل فحق عقاب
38.tr: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
38.tl: In kullun illa kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa AAiqabi

38.t: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
38.c: وما ينظر هؤلاء إلا صيحة واحدة ما لها من فواق
38.tr: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
38.tl: Wama yanthuru haolai illa sayhatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaqin

38.t: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
38.c: وقالوا ربنا عجل لنا قطنا قبل يوم الحساب
38.tr: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"
38.tl: Waqaloo rabbana AAajjil lana qittana qabla yawmi alhisabi

38.t: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38.c: اصبر على ما يقولون واذكر عبدنا داوود ذا الأيد إنه أواب
38.tr: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].
38.tl: Isbir AAala ma yaqooloona waothkur AAabdana dawooda tha alaydi innahu awwabun

38.t: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
38.c: إنا سخرنا الجبال معه يسبحن بالعشي والإشراق
38.tr: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
38.tl: Inna sakhkharna aljibala maAAahu yusabbihna bialAAashiyyi waalishraqi

38.t: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38.c: والطير محشورة كل له أواب
38.tr: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
38.tl: Waalttayra mahshooratan kullun lahu awwabun

38.t: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
38.c: وشددنا ملكه وآتيناه الحكمة وفصل الخطاب
38.tr: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
38.tl: Washadadna mulkahu waataynahu alhikmata wafasla alkhitabi

38.t: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
38.c: وهل أتاك نبأ الخصم إذ تسوروا المحراب
38.tr: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
38.tl: Wahal ataka nabao alkhasmi ith tasawwaroo almihraba

38.t: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
38.c: إذ دخلوا على داوود ففزع منهم قالوا لا تخف خصمان بغى بعضنا على بعض فاحكم بيننا بالحق ولا تشطط واهدنا إلى سواء الصراط
38.tr: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
38.tl: Ith dakhaloo AAala dawooda fafaziAAa minhum qaloo la takhaf khasmani bagha baAAduna AAala baAAdin faohkum baynana bialhaqqi wala tushtit waihdina ila sawai alssirati

38.t: إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
38.c: إن هذا أخي له تسع وتسعون نعجة ولي نعجة واحدة فقال أكفلنيها وعزني في الخطاب
38.tr: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
38.tl: Inna hatha akhee lahu tisAAun watisAAoona naAAjatan waliya naAAjatun wahidatun faqala akfilneeha waAAazzanee fee alkhitabi

38.t: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩
38.c: قال لقد ظلمك بسؤال نعجتك إلى نعاجه وإن كثيرا من الخلطاء ليبغي بعضهم على بعض إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات وقليل ما هم وظن داوود أنما فتناه فاستغفر ربه وخر راكعا وأناب
38.tr: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].
38.tl: Qala laqad thalamaka bisuali naAAjatika ila niAAajihi wainna katheeran mina alkhulatai layabghee baAAduhum AAala baAAdin illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waqaleelun ma hum wathanna dawoodu annama fatannahu faistaghfara rabbahu wakharra rakiAAan waanaba

38.t: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
38.c: فغفرنا له ذلك وإن له عندنا لزلفى وحسن مآب
38.tr: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
38.tl: Faghafarna lahu thalika wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin

38.t: يَـٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
38.c: يا داوود إنا جعلناك خليفة في الأرض فاحكم بين الناس بالحق ولا تتبع الهوى فيضلك عن سبيل الله إن الذين يضلون عن سبيل الله لهم عذاب شديد بما نسوا يوم الحساب
38.tr: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
38.tl: Ya dawoodu inna jaAAalnaka khaleefatan fee alardi faohkum bayna alnnasi bialhaqqi wala tattabiAAi alhawa fayudillaka AAan sabeeli Allahi inna allatheena yadilloona AAan sabeeli Allahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun bima nasoo yawma alhisabi

38.t: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
38.c: وما خلقنا السماء والأرض وما بينهما باطلا ذلك ظن الذين كفروا فويل للذين كفروا من النار
38.tr: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
38.tl: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma batilan thalika thannu allatheena kafaroo fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo mina alnnari

38.t: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
38.c: أم نجعل الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات كالمفسدين في الأرض أم نجعل المتقين كالفجار
38.tr: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?
38.tl: Am najAAalu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kaalmufsideena fee alardi am najAAalu almuttaqeena kaalfujjari

38.t: كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
38.c: كتاب أنزلناه إليك مبارك ليدبروا آياته وليتذكر أولو الألباب
38.tr: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
38.tl: Kitabun anzalnahu ilayka mubarakun liyaddabbaroo ayatihi waliyatathakkara oloo alalbabi

38.t: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38.c: ووهبنا لداوود سليمان نعم العبد إنه أواب
38.tr: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
38.tl: Wawahabna lidawooda sulaymana niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun

38.t: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
38.c: إذ عرض عليه بالعشي الصافنات الجياد
38.tr: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
38.tl: Ith AAurida AAalayhi bialAAashiyyi alssafinatu aljiyadu

38.t: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
38.c: فقال إني أحببت حب الخير عن ذكر ربي حتى توارت بالحجاب
38.tr: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
38.tl: Faqala innee ahbabtu hubba alkhayri AAan thikri rabbee hatta tawarat bialhijabi

38.t: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
38.c: ردوها علي فطفق مسحا بالسوق والأعناق
38.tr: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
38.tl: Ruddooha AAalayya fatafiqa mashan bialssooqi waalaAAnaqi

38.t: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
38.c: ولقد فتنا سليمان وألقينا على كرسيه جسدا ثم أناب
38.tr: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
38.tl: Walaqad fatanna sulaymana waalqayna AAala kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anaba

38.t: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
38.c: قال رب اغفر لي وهب لي ملكا لا ينبغي لأحد من بعدي إنك أنت الوهاب
38.tr: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
38.tl: Qala rabbi ighfir lee wahab lee mulkan la yanbaghee liahadin min baAAdee innaka anta alwahhabu

38.t: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
38.c: فسخرنا له الريح تجري بأمره رخاء حيث أصاب
38.tr: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
38.tl: Fasakhkharna lahu alrreeha tajree biamrihi rukhaan haythu asaba

38.t: وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
38.c: والشياطين كل بناء وغواص
38.tr: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
38.tl: Waalshshayateena kulla bannain waghawwasin

38.t: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
38.c: وآخرين مقرنين في الأصفاد
38.tr: And others bound together in shackles.
38.tl: Waakhareena muqarraneena fee alasfadi

38.t: هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
38.c: هذا عطاؤنا فامنن أو أمسك بغير حساب
38.tr: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
38.tl: Hatha AAataona faomnun aw amsik bighayri hisabin

38.t: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
38.c: وإن له عندنا لزلفى وحسن مآب
38.tr: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
38.tl: Wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin

38.t: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
38.c: واذكر عبدنا أيوب إذ نادى ربه أني مسني الشيطان بنصب وعذاب
38.tr: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
38.tl: Waothkur AAabdana ayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alshshaytanu binusbin waAAathabin

38.t: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
38.c: اركض برجلك هذا مغتسل بارد وشراب
38.tr: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."
38.tl: Orkud birijlika hatha mughtasalun baridun washarabun

38.t: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
38.c: ووهبنا له أهله ومثلهم معهم رحمة منا وذكرى لأولي الألباب
38.tr: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
38.tl: Wawahabna lahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan minna wathikra liolee alalbabi

38.t: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38.c: وخذ بيدك ضغثا فاضرب به ولا تحنث إنا وجدناه صابرا نعم العبد إنه أواب
38.tr: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
38.tl: Wakhuth biyadika dighthan faidrib bihi wala tahnath inna wajadnahu sabiran niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun

38.t: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
38.c: واذكر عبادنا إبراهيم وإسحاق ويعقوب أولي الأيدي والأبصار
38.tr: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
38.tl: Waothkur AAibadana ibraheema waishaqa wayaAAqooba olee alaydee waalabsari

38.t: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
38.c: إنا أخلصناهم بخالصة ذكرى الدار
38.tr: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
38.tl: Inna akhlasnahum bikhalisatin thikra alddari

38.t: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
38.c: وإنهم عندنا لمن المصطفين الأخيار
38.tr: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
38.tl: Wainnahum AAindana lamina almustafayna alakhyari

38.t: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
38.c: واذكر إسماعيل واليسع وذا الكفل وكل من الأخيار
38.tr: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
38.tl: Waothkur ismaAAeela wailyasaAAa watha alkifli wakullun mina alakhyari

38.t: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
38.c: هذا ذكر وإن للمتقين لحسن مآب
38.tr: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return
38.tl: Hatha thikrun wainna lilmuttaqeena lahusna maabin

38.t: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
38.c: جنات عدن مفتحة لهم الأبواب
38.tr: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
38.tl: Jannati AAadnin mufattahatan lahumu alabwabu

38.t: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
38.c: متكئين فيها يدعون فيها بفاكهة كثيرة وشراب
38.tr: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
38.tl: Muttakieena feeha yadAAoona feeha bifakihatin katheeratin washarabin

38.t: وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
38.c: وعندهم قاصرات الطرف أتراب
38.tr: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
38.tl: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi atrabun

38.t: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
38.c: هذا ما توعدون ليوم الحساب
38.tr: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
38.tl: Hatha ma tooAAadoona liyawmi alhisabi

38.t: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
38.c: إن هذا لرزقنا ما له من نفاد
38.tr: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
38.tl: Inna hatha larizquna ma lahu min nafadin

38.t: هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّـٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ
38.c: هذا وإن للطاغين لشر مآب
38.tr: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
38.tl: Hatha wainna lilttagheena lasharra maabin

38.t: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
38.c: جهنم يصلونها فبئس المهاد
38.tr: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
38.tl: Jahannama yaslawnaha fabisa almihadu

38.t: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
38.c: هذا فليذوقوه حميم وغساق
38.tr: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
38.tl: Hatha falyathooqoohu hameemun waghassaqun

38.t: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
38.c: وآخر من شكله أزواج
38.tr: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
38.tl: Waakharu min shaklihi azwajun

38.t: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
38.c: هذا فوج مقتحم معكم لا مرحبا بهم إنهم صالو النار
38.tr: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
38.tl: Hatha fawjun muqtahimun maAAakum la marhaban bihim innahum saloo alnnari

38.t: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
38.c: قالوا بل أنتم لا مرحبا بكم أنتم قدمتموه لنا فبئس القرار
38.tr: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
38.tl: Qaloo bal antum la marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumoohu lana fabisa alqararu

38.t: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
38.c: قالوا ربنا من قدم لنا هذا فزده عذابا ضعفا في النار
38.tr: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
38.tl: Qaloo rabbana man qaddama lana hatha fazidhu AAathaban diAAfan fee alnnari

38.t: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
38.c: وقالوا ما لنا لا نرى رجالا كنا نعدهم من الأشرار
38.tr: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
38.tl: Waqaloo ma lana la nara rijalan kunna naAAudduhum mina alashrari

38.t: أَتَّخَذْنَـٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
38.c: أتخذناهم سخريا أم زاغت عنهم الأبصار
38.tr: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
38.tl: Attakhathnahum sikhriyyan am zaghat AAanhumu alabsaru

38.t: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
38.c: إن ذلك لحق تخاصم أهل النار
38.tr: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
38.tl: Inna thalika lahaqqun takhasumu ahli alnnari

38.t: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
38.c: قل إنما أنا منذر وما من إله إلا الله الواحد القهار
38.tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
38.tl: Qul innama ana munthirun wama min ilahin illa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu

38.t: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ
38.c: رب السماوات والأرض وما بينهما العزيز الغفار
38.tr: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
38.tl: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alAAazeezu alghaffaru

38.t: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
38.c: قل هو نبأ عظيم
38.tr: Say, "It is great news
38.tl: Qul huwa nabaon AAatheemun

38.t: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
38.c: أنتم عنه معرضون
38.tr: From which you turn away.
38.tl: Antum AAanhu muAAridoona

38.t: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
38.c: ما كان لي من علم بالملإ الأعلى إذ يختصمون
38.tr: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
38.tl: Ma kana liya min AAilmin bialmalai alaAAla ith yakhtasimoona

38.t: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
38.c: إن يوحى إلي إلا أنما أنا نذير مبين
38.tr: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
38.tl: In yooha ilayya illa annama ana natheerun mubeenun

38.t: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ
38.c: إذ قال ربك للملائكة إني خالق بشرا من طين
38.tr: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
38.tl: Ith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min teenin

38.t: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
38.c: فإذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له ساجدين
38.tr: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
38.tl: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena

38.t: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
38.c: فسجد الملائكة كلهم أجمعون
38.tr: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.
38.tl: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona

38.t: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
38.c: إلا إبليس استكبر وكان من الكافرين
38.tr: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
38.tl: Illa ibleesa istakbara wakana mina alkafireena

38.t: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
38.c: قال يا إبليس ما منعك أن تسجد لما خلقت بيدي أستكبرت أم كنت من العالين
38.tr: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
38.tl: Qala ya ibleesu ma manaAAaka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina alAAaleena

38.t: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ
38.c: قال أنا خير منه خلقتني من نار وخلقته من طين
38.tr: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
38.tl: Qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin

38.t: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
38.c: قال فاخرج منها فإنك رجيم
38.tr: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.
38.tl: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun

38.t: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
38.c: وإن عليك لعنتي إلى يوم الدين
38.tr: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
38.tl: Wainna AAalayka laAAnatee ila yawmi alddeeni

38.t: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
38.c: قال رب فأنظرني إلى يوم يبعثون
38.tr: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
38.tl: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona

38.t: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
38.c: قال فإنك من المنظرين
38.tr: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
38.tl: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena

38.t: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
38.c: إلى يوم الوقت المعلوم
38.tr: Until the Day of the time well-known."
38.tl: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi

38.t: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
38.c: قال فبعزتك لأغوينهم أجمعين
38.tr: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all
38.tl: Qala fabiAAizzatika laoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena

38.t: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
38.c: إلا عبادك منهم المخلصين
38.tr: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
38.tl: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena

38.t: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
38.c: قال فالحق والحق أقول
38.tr: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
38.tl: Qala faalhaqqu waalhaqqa aqoolu

38.t: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
38.c: لأملأن جهنم منك وممن تبعك منهم أجمعين
38.tr: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
38.tl: Laamlaanna jahannama minka wamimman tabiAAaka minhum ajmaAAeena

38.t: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
38.c: قل ما أسألكم عليه من أجر وما أنا من المتكلفين
38.tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious
38.tl: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin wama ana mina almutakallifeena

38.t: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
38.c: إن هو إلا ذكر للعالمين
38.tr: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
38.tl: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena

38.t: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
38.c: ولتعلمن نبأه بعد حين
38.tr: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
38.tl: WalataAAlamunna nabaahu baAAda heenin

39.t: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
39.c: تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز الحكيم
39.tr: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
39.tl: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi

39.t: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
39.c: إنا أنزلنا إليك الكتاب بالحق فاعبد الله مخلصا له الدين
39.tr: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
39.tl: Inna anzalna ilayka alkitaba bialhaqqi faoAAbudi Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena

39.t: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَـٰذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ
39.c: ألا لله الدين الخالص والذين اتخذوا من دونه أولياء ما نعبدهم إلا ليقربونا إلى الله زلفى إن الله يحكم بينهم في ما هم فيه يختلفون إن الله لا يهدي من هو كاذب كفار
39.tr: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.
39.tl: Ala lillahi alddeenu alkhalisu waallatheena ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa ma naAAbuduhum illa liyuqarriboona ila Allahi zulfa inna Allaha yahkumu baynahum fee ma hum feehi yakhtalifoona inna Allaha la yahdee man huwa kathibun kaffarun

39.t: لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
39.c: لو أراد الله أن يتخذ ولدا لاصطفى مما يخلق ما يشاء سبحانه هو الله الواحد القهار
39.tr: If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
39.tl: Law arada Allahu an yattakhitha waladan laistafa mimma yakhluqu ma yashao subhanahu huwa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu

39.t: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ
39.c: خلق السماوات والأرض بالحق يكور الليل على النهار ويكور النهار على الليل وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري لأجل مسمى ألا هو العزيز الغفار
39.tr: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
39.tl: Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi yukawwiru allayla AAala alnnahari wayukawwiru alnnahara AAala allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman ala huwa alAAazeezu alghaffaru

39.t: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتٍ ثَلَـٰثٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
39.c: خلقكم من نفس واحدة ثم جعل منها زوجها وأنزل لكم من الأنعام ثمانية أزواج يخلقكم في بطون أمهاتكم خلقا من بعد خلق في ظلمات ثلاث ذلكم الله ربكم له الملك لا إله إلا هو فأنى تصرفون
39.tr: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
39.tl: Khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin thumma jaAAala minha zawjaha waanzala lakum mina alanAAami thamaniyata azwajin yakhluqukum fee butooni ommahatikum khalqan min baAAdi khalqin fee thulumatin thalathin thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku la ilaha illa huwa faanna tusrafoona

39.t: إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
39.c: إن تكفروا فإن الله غني عنكم ولا يرضى لعباده الكفر وإن تشكروا يرضه لكم ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى ثم إلى ربكم مرجعكم فينبئكم بما كنتم تعملون إنه عليم بذات الصدور
39.tr: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allah is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
39.tl: In takfuroo fainna Allaha ghaniyyun AAankum wala yarda liAAibadihi alkufra wain tashkuroo yardahu lakum wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra thumma ila rabbikum marjiAAukum fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

39.t: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةً مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
39.c: وإذا مس الإنسان ضر دعا ربه منيبا إليه ثم إذا خوله نعمة منه نسي ما كان يدعو إليه من قبل وجعل لله أندادا ليضل عن سبيله قل تمتع بكفرك قليلا إنك من أصحاب النار
39.tr: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."
39.tl: Waitha massa alinsana durrun daAAa rabbahu muneeban ilayhi thumma itha khawwalahu niAAmatan minhu nasiya ma kana yadAAoo ilayhi min qablu wajaAAala lillahi andadan liyudilla AAan sabeelihi qul tamattaAA bikufrika qaleelan innaka min ashabi alnnari

39.t: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَـٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَآئِمًا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
39.c: أمن هو قانت آناء الليل ساجدا وقائما يحذر الآخرة ويرجو رحمة ربه قل هل يستوي الذين يعلمون والذين لا يعلمون إنما يتذكر أولو الألباب
39.tr: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
39.tl: Amman huwa qanitun anaa allayli sajidan waqaiman yahtharu alakhirata wayarjoo rahmata rabbihi qul hal yastawee allatheena yaAAlamoona waallatheena la yaAAlamoona innama yatathakkaru oloo alalbabi

39.t: قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۗ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّـٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
39.c: قل يا عباد الذين آمنوا اتقوا ربكم للذين أحسنوا في هذه الدنيا حسنة وأرض الله واسعة إنما يوفى الصابرون أجرهم بغير حساب
39.tr: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account."
39.tl: Qul ya AAibadi allatheena amanoo ittaqoo rabbakum lillatheena ahsanoo fee hathihi alddunya hasanatun waardu Allahi wasiAAatun innama yuwaffa alssabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisabin

39.t: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
39.c: قل إني أمرت أن أعبد الله مخلصا له الدين
39.tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
39.tl: Qul innee omirtu an aAAbuda Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena

39.t: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
39.c: وأمرت لأن أكون أول المسلمين
39.tr: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."
39.tl: Waomirtu lian akoona awwala almuslimeena

39.t: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
39.c: قل إني أخاف إن عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
39.tr: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
39.tl: Qul innee akhafu in AAasaytu rabbee AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

39.t: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُۥ دِينِى
39.c: قل الله أعبد مخلصا له ديني
39.tr: Say, "Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
39.tl: Quli Allaha aAAbudu mukhlisan lahu deenee

39.t: فَٱعْبُدُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
39.c: فاعبدوا ما شئتم من دونه قل إن الخاسرين الذين خسروا أنفسهم وأهليهم يوم القيامة ألا ذلك هو الخسران المبين
39.tr: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."
39.tl: FaoAAbudoo ma shitum min doonihi qul inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala thalika huwa alkhusranu almubeenu

39.t: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥ ۚ يَـٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
39.c: لهم من فوقهم ظلل من النار ومن تحتهم ظلل ذلك يخوف الله به عباده يا عباد فاتقون
39.tr: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.
39.tl: Lahum min fawqihim thulalun mina alnnari wamin tahtihim thulalun thalika yukhawwifu Allahu bihi AAibadahu ya AAibadi faittaqooni

39.t: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُوا۟ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ
39.c: والذين اجتنبوا الطاغوت أن يعبدوها وأنابوا إلى الله لهم البشرى فبشر عباد
39.tr: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
39.tl: Waallatheena ijtanaboo alttaghoota an yaAAbudooha waanaboo ila Allahi lahumu albushra fabashshir AAibadi

39.t: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُۥٓ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
39.c: الذين يستمعون القول فيتبعون أحسنه أولئك الذين هداهم الله وأولئك هم أولو الألباب
39.tr: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding.
39.tl: Allatheena yastamiAAoona alqawla fayattabiAAoona ahsanahu olaika allatheena hadahumu Allahu waolaika hum oloo alalbabi

39.t: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ
39.c: أفمن حق عليه كلمة العذاب أفأنت تنقذ من في النار
39.tr: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
39.tl: Afaman haqqa AAalayhi kalimatu alAAathabi afaanta tunqithu man fee alnnari

39.t: لَـٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
39.c: لكن الذين اتقوا ربهم لهم غرف من فوقها غرف مبنية تجري من تحتها الأنهار وعد الله لا يخلف الله الميعاد
39.tr: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in [His] promise.
39.tl: Lakini allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqiha ghurafun mabniyyatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu waAAda Allahi la yukhlifu Allahu almeeAAada

39.t: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَـٰبِيعَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ حُطَـٰمًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
39.c: ألم تر أن الله أنزل من السماء ماء فسلكه ينابيع في الأرض ثم يخرج به زرعا مختلفا ألوانه ثم يهيج فتراه مصفرا ثم يجعله حطاما إن في ذلك لذكرى لأولي الألباب
39.tr: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
39.tl: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan fasalakahu yanabeeAAa fee alardi thumma yukhriju bihi zarAAan mukhtalifan alwanuhu thumma yaheeju fatarahu musfarran thumma yajAAaluhu hutaman inna fee thalika lathikra liolee alalbabi

39.t: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَـٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْقَـٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
39.c: أفمن شرح الله صدره للإسلام فهو على نور من ربه فويل للقاسية قلوبهم من ذكر الله أولئك في ضلال مبين
39.tr: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error.
39.tl: Afaman sharaha Allahu sadrahu lilislami fahuwa AAala noorin min rabbihi fawaylun lilqasiyati quloobuhum min thikri Allahi olaika fee dalalin mubeenin

39.t: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ كِتَـٰبًا مُّتَشَـٰبِهًا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
39.c: الله نزل أحسن الحديث كتابا متشابها مثاني تقشعر منه جلود الذين يخشون ربهم ثم تلين جلودهم وقلوبهم إلى ذكر الله ذلك هدى الله يهدي به من يشاء ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد
39.tr: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
39.tl: Allahu nazzala ahsana alhadeethi kitaban mutashabihan mathaniya taqshaAAirru minhu juloodu allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum thumma taleenu julooduhum waquloobuhum ila thikri Allahi thalika huda Allahi yahdee bihi man yashao waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin

39.t: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِى بِوَجْهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
39.c: أفمن يتقي بوجهه سوء العذاب يوم القيامة وقيل للظالمين ذوقوا ما كنتم تكسبون
39.tr: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."
39.tl: Afaman yattaqee biwajhihi sooa alAAathabi yawma alqiyamati waqeela lilththalimeena thooqoo ma kuntum taksiboona

39.t: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
39.c: كذب الذين من قبلهم فأتاهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون
39.tr: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
39.tl: Kaththaba allatheena min qablihim faatahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona

39.t: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخِزْىَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
39.c: فأذاقهم الله الخزي في الحياة الدنيا ولعذاب الآخرة أكبر لو كانوا يعلمون
39.tr: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
39.tl: Faathaqahumu Allahu alkhizya fee alhayati alddunya walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona

39.t: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
39.c: ولقد ضربنا للناس في هذا القرآن من كل مثل لعلهم يتذكرون
39.tr: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
39.tl: Walaqad darabna lilnnasi fee hatha alqurani min kulli mathalin laAAallahum yatathakkaroona

39.t: قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِى عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
39.c: قرآنا عربيا غير ذي عوج لعلهم يتقون
39.tr: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous.
39.tl: Quranan AAarabiyyan ghayra thee AAiwajin laAAallahum yattaqoona

39.t: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَـٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
39.c: ضرب الله مثلا رجلا فيه شركاء متشاكسون ورجلا سلما لرجل هل يستويان مثلا الحمد لله بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون
39.tr: Allah presents an example: a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! But most of them do not know.
39.tl: Daraba Allahu mathalan rajulan feehi shurakao mutashakisoona warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyani mathalan alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona

39.t: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
39.c: إنك ميت وإنهم ميتون
39.tr: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.
39.tl: Innaka mayyitun wainnahum mayyitoona

39.t: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ
39.c: ثم إنكم يوم القيامة عند ربكم تختصمون
39.tr: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.
39.tl: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati AAinda rabbikum takhtasimoona

39.t: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَآءَهُۥٓ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
39.c: فمن أظلم ممن كذب على الله وكذب بالصدق إذ جاءه أليس في جهنم مثوى للكافرين
39.tr: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?
39.tl: Faman athlamu mimman kathaba AAala Allahi wakaththaba bialssidqi ith jaahu alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilkafireena

39.t: وَٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ ۙ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ
39.c: والذي جاء بالصدق وصدق به أولئك هم المتقون
39.tr: And the one who has brought the truth and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.
39.tl: Waallathee jaa bialssidqi wasaddaqa bihi olaika humu almuttaqoona

39.t: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
39.c: لهم ما يشاءون عند ربهم ذلك جزاء المحسنين
39.tr: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -
39.tl: Lahum ma yashaoona AAinda rabbihim thalika jazao almuhsineena

39.t: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
39.c: ليكفر الله عنهم أسوأ الذي عملوا ويجزيهم أجرهم بأحسن الذي كانوا يعملون
39.tr: That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.
39.tl: Liyukaffira Allahu AAanhum aswaa allathee AAamiloo wayajziyahum ajrahum biahsani allathee kanoo yaAAmaloona

39.t: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
39.c: أليس الله بكاف عبده ويخوفونك بالذين من دونه ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد
39.tr: Is not Allah sufficient for His Servant [Prophet Muhammad]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
39.tl: Alaysa Allahu bikafin AAabdahu wayukhawwifoonaka biallatheena min doonihi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin

39.t: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّ ۗ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِى ٱنتِقَامٍ
39.c: ومن يهد الله فما له من مضل أليس الله بعزيز ذي انتقام
39.tr: And whoever Allah guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allah Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?
39.tl: Waman yahdi Allahu fama lahu min mudillin alaysa Allahu biAAazeezin thee intiqamin

39.t: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَـٰشِفَـٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوْ أَرَادَنِى بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَـٰتُ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
39.c: ولئن سألتهم من خلق السماوات والأرض ليقولن الله قل أفرأيتم ما تدعون من دون الله إن أرادني الله بضر هل هن كاشفات ضره أو أرادني برحمة هل هن ممسكات رحمته قل حسبي الله عليه يتوكل المتوكلون
39.tr: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."
39.tl: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna Allahu qul afaraaytum ma tadAAoona min dooni Allahi in aradaniya Allahu bidurrin hal hunna kashifatu durrihi aw aradanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikatu rahmatihi qul hasbiya Allahu AAalayhi yatawakkalu almutawakkiloona

39.t: قُلْ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَـٰمِلٌ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
39.c: قل يا قوم اعملوا على مكانتكم إني عامل فسوف تعلمون
39.tr: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know
39.tl: Qul ya qawmi iAAmaloo AAala makanatikum innee AAamilun fasawfa taAAlamoona

39.t: مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
39.c: من يأتيه عذاب يخزيه ويحل عليه عذاب مقيم
39.tr: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."
39.tl: Man yateehi AAathabun yukhzeehi wayahillu AAalayhi AAathabun muqeemun

39.t: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
39.c: إنا أنزلنا عليك الكتاب للناس بالحق فمن اهتدى فلنفسه ومن ضل فإنما يضل عليها وما أنت عليهم بوكيل
39.tr: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager over them.
39.tl: Inna anzalna AAalayka alkitaba lilnnasi bialhaqqi famani ihtada falinafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu AAalayha wama anta AAalayhim biwakeelin

39.t: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَٱلَّتِى لَمْ تَمُتْ فِى مَنَامِهَا ۖ فَيُمْسِكُ ٱلَّتِى قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
39.c: الله يتوفى الأنفس حين موتها والتي لم تمت في منامها فيمسك التي قضى عليها الموت ويرسل الأخرى إلى أجل مسمى إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يتفكرون
39.tr: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
39.tl: Allahu yatawaffa alanfusa heena mawtiha waallatee lam tamut fee manamiha fayumsiku allatee qada AAalayha almawta wayursilu alokhra ila ajalin musamman inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona

39.t: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَ ۚ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
39.c: أم اتخذوا من دون الله شفعاء قل أولو كانوا لا يملكون شيئا ولا يعقلون
39.tr: Or have they taken other than Allah as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"
39.tl: Ami ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi shufaAAaa qul awalaw kanoo la yamlikoona shayan wala yaAAqiloona

39.t: قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ جَمِيعًا ۖ لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
39.c: قل لله الشفاعة جميعا له ملك السماوات والأرض ثم إليه ترجعون
39.tr: Say, "To Allah belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."
39.tl: Qul lillahi alshshafaAAatu jameeAAan lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi thumma ilayhi turjaAAoona

39.t: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ ٱشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
39.c: وإذا ذكر الله وحده اشمأزت قلوب الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة وإذا ذكر الذين من دونه إذا هم يستبشرون
39.tr: And when Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.
39.tl: Waitha thukira Allahu wahdahu ishmaazzat quloobu allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati waitha thukira allatheena min doonihi itha hum yastabshiroona

39.t: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ عَـٰلِمَ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِى مَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
39.c: قل اللهم فاطر السماوات والأرض عالم الغيب والشهادة أنت تحكم بين عبادك في ما كانوا فيه يختلفون
39.tr: Say, "O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."
39.tl: Quli allahumma fatira alssamawati waalardi AAalima alghaybi waalshshahadati anta tahkumu bayna AAibadika fee ma kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona

39.t: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَحْتَسِبُونَ
39.c: ولو أن للذين ظلموا ما في الأرض جميعا ومثله معه لافتدوا به من سوء العذاب يوم القيامة وبدا لهم من الله ما لم يكونوا يحتسبون
