71.t: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
71.c: رب اغفر لي ولوالدي ولمن دخل بيتي مؤمنا وللمؤمنين والمؤمنات ولا تزد الظالمين إلا تبارا
71.tr: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
71.tl: Rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muminan walilmumineena waalmuminati wala tazidi alththalimeena illa tabaran

72.t: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
72.c: قل أوحي إلي أنه استمع نفر من الجن فقالوا إنا سمعنا قرآنا عجبا
72.tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.
72.tl: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istamaAAa nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna samiAAna quranan AAajaban

72.t: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
72.c: يهدي إلى الرشد فآمنا به ولن نشرك بربنا أحدا
72.tr: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
72.tl: Yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan

72.t: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
72.c: وأنه تعالى جد ربنا ما اتخذ صاحبة ولا ولدا
72.tr: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
72.tl: Waannahu taAAala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan

72.t: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
72.c: وأنه كان يقول سفيهنا على الله شططا
72.tr: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.
72.tl: Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna AAala Allahi shatatan

72.t: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
72.c: وأنا ظننا أن لن تقول الإنس والجن على الله كذبا
72.tr: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.
72.tl: Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu AAala Allahi kathiban

72.t: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
72.c: وأنه كان رجال من الإنس يعوذون برجال من الجن فزادوهم رهقا
72.tr: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.
72.tl: Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi yaAAoothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan

72.t: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
72.c: وأنهم ظنوا كما ظننتم أن لن يبعث الله أحدا
72.tr: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
72.tl: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan

72.t: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
72.c: وأنا لمسنا السماء فوجدناها ملئت حرسا شديدا وشهبا
72.tr: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
72.tl: Waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban

72.t: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
72.c: وأنا كنا نقعد منها مقاعد للسمع فمن يستمع الآن يجد له شهابا رصدا
72.tr: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
72.tl: Waanna kunna naqAAudu minha maqaAAida lilssamAAi faman yastamiAAi alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan

72.t: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
72.c: وأنا لا ندري أشر أريد بمن في الأرض أم أراد بهم ربهم رشدا
72.tr: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
72.tl: Waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan

72.t: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا
72.c: وأنا منا الصالحون ومنا دون ذلك كنا طرائق قددا
72.tr: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
72.tl: Waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan

72.t: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا
72.c: وأنا ظننا أن لن نعجز الله في الأرض ولن نعجزه هربا
72.tr: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
72.tl: Wanna thananna an lan nuAAjiza Allaha fee alardi walan nuAAjizahu haraban

72.t: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
72.c: وأنا لما سمعنا الهدى آمنا به فمن يؤمن بربه فلا يخاف بخسا ولا رهقا
72.tr: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
72.tl: Waanna lamma samiAAna alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan

72.t: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا
72.c: وأنا منا المسلمون ومنا القاسطون فمن أسلم فأولئك تحروا رشدا
72.tr: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
72.tl: Waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan

72.t: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
72.c: وأما القاسطون فكانوا لجهنم حطبا
72.tr: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
72.tl: Waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban

72.t: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا
72.c: وأن لو استقاموا على الطريقة لأسقيناهم ماء غدقا
72.tr: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
72.tl: Waallawi istaqamoo AAala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan

72.t: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
72.c: لنفتنهم فيه ومن يعرض عن ذكر ربه يسلكه عذابا صعدا
72.tr: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
72.tl: Linaftinahum feehi waman yuAArid AAan thikri rabbihi yaslukhu AAathaban saAAadan

72.t: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا
72.c: وأن المساجد لله فلا تدعوا مع الله أحدا
72.tr: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone.
72.tl: Waanna almasajida lillahi fala tadAAoo maAAa Allahi ahadan

72.t: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
72.c: وأنه لما قام عبد الله يدعوه كادوا يكونون عليه لبدا
72.tr: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
72.tl: Waannahu lamma qama AAabdu Allahi yadAAoohu kadoo yakoonoona AAalayhi libadan

72.t: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
72.c: قل إنما أدعو ربي ولا أشرك به أحدا
72.tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
72.tl: Qul innama adAAoo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan

72.t: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
72.c: قل إني لا أملك لكم ضرا ولا رشدا
72.tr: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
72.tl: Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan

72.t: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
72.c: قل إني لن يجيرني من الله أحد ولن أجد من دونه ملتحدا
72.tr: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
72.tl: Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan

72.t: إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
72.c: إلا بلاغا من الله ورسالاته ومن يعص الله ورسوله فإن له نار جهنم خالدين فيها أبدا
72.tr: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
72.tl: Illa balaghan mina Allahi warisalatihi waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan

72.t: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
72.c: حتى إذا رأوا ما يوعدون فسيعلمون من أضعف ناصرا وأقل عددا
72.tr: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
72.tl: Hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona fasayaAAlamoona man adAAafu nasiran waaqallu AAadadan

72.t: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
72.c: قل إن أدري أقريب ما توعدون أم يجعل له ربي أمدا
72.tr: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
72.tl: Qul in adree aqareebun ma tooAAadoona am yajAAalu lahu rabbee amadan

72.t: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
72.c: عالم الغيب فلا يظهر على غيبه أحدا
72.tr: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
72.tl: AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan

72.t: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا
72.c: إلا من ارتضى من رسول فإنه يسلك من بين يديه ومن خلفه رصدا
72.tr: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
72.tl: Illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan

72.t: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
72.c: ليعلم أن قد أبلغوا رسالات ربهم وأحاط بما لديهم وأحصى كل شيء عددا
72.tr: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
72.tl: LiyaAAlama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin AAadadan

73.t: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
73.c: يا أيها المزمل
73.tr: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],
73.tl: Ya ayyuha almuzzammilu

73.t: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
73.c: قم الليل إلا قليلا
73.tr: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
73.tl: Qumi allayla illa qaleelan

73.t: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
73.c: نصفه أو انقص منه قليلا
73.tr: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
73.tl: Nisfahu awi onqus minhu qaleelan

73.t: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
73.c: أو زد عليه ورتل القرآن ترتيلا
73.tr: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
73.tl: Aw zid AAalayhi warattili alqurana tarteelan

73.t: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
73.c: إنا سنلقي عليك قولا ثقيلا
73.tr: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
73.tl: Inna sanulqee AAalayka qawlan thaqeelan

73.t: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
73.c: إن ناشئة الليل هي أشد وطئا وأقوم قيلا
73.tr: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
73.tl: Inna nashiata allayli hiya ashaddu watan waaqwamu qeelan

73.t: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
73.c: إن لك في النهار سبحا طويلا
73.tr: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
73.tl: Inna laka fee alnnahari sabhan taweelan

73.t: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
73.c: واذكر اسم ربك وتبتل إليه تبتيلا
73.tr: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
73.tl: Waothkuri isma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabteelan

73.t: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا
73.c: رب المشرق والمغرب لا إله إلا هو فاتخذه وكيلا
73.tr: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
73.tl: Rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi la ilaha illa huwa faittakhithhu wakeelan

73.t: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا
73.c: واصبر على ما يقولون واهجرهم هجرا جميلا
73.tr: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
73.tl: Waisbir AAala ma yaqooloona waohjurhum hajran jameelan

73.t: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
73.c: وذرني والمكذبين أولي النعمة ومهلهم قليلا
73.tr: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
73.tl: Watharnee waalmukaththibeena olee alnnaAAmati wamahhilhum qaleelan

73.t: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
73.c: إن لدينا أنكالا وجحيما
73.tr: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
73.tl: Inna ladayna ankalan wajaheeman

73.t: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
73.c: وطعاما ذا غصة وعذابا أليما
73.tr: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
73.tl: WataAAaman tha ghussatin waAAathaban aleeman

73.t: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
73.c: يوم ترجف الأرض والجبال وكانت الجبال كثيبا مهيلا
73.tr: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
73.tl: Yawma tarjufu alardu waaljibalu wakanati aljibalu katheeban maheelan

73.t: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
73.c: إنا أرسلنا إليكم رسولا شاهدا عليكم كما أرسلنا إلى فرعون رسولا
73.tr: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
73.tl: Inna arsalna ilaykum rasoolan shahidan AAalaykum kama arsalna ila firAAawna rasoolan

73.t: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
73.c: فعصى فرعون الرسول فأخذناه أخذا وبيلا
73.tr: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
73.tl: FaAAasa firAAawnu alrrasoola faakhathnahu akhthan wabeelan

73.t: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
73.c: فكيف تتقون إن كفرتم يوما يجعل الولدان شيبا
73.tr: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?
73.tl: Fakayfa tattaqoona in kafartum yawman yajAAalu alwildana sheeban

73.t: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
73.c: السماء منفطر به كان وعده مفعولا
73.tr: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
73.tl: Alssamao munfatirun bihi kana waAAduhu mafAAoolan

73.t: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
73.c: إن هذه تذكرة فمن شاء اتخذ إلى ربه سبيلا
73.tr: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
73.tl: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan

73.t: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
73.c: إن ربك يعلم أنك تقوم أدنى من ثلثي الليل ونصفه وثلثه وطائفة من الذين معك والله يقدر الليل والنهار علم أن لن تحصوه فتاب عليكم فاقرءوا ما تيسر من القرآن علم أن سيكون منكم مرضى وآخرون يضربون في الأرض يبتغون من فضل الله وآخرون يقاتلون في سبيل الله فاقرءوا ما تيسر منه وأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة وأقرضوا الله قرضا حسنا وما تقدموا لأنفسكم من خير تجدوه عند الله هو خيرا وأعظم أجرا واستغفروا الله إن الله غفور رحيم
73.tr: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
73.tl: Inna rabbaka yaAAlamu annaka taqoomu adna min thuluthayi allayli wanisfahu wathuluthahu wataifatun mina allatheena maAAaka waAllahu yuqaddiru allayla waalnnahara AAalima an lan tuhsoohu fataba AAalaykum faiqraoo ma tayassara mina alqurani AAalima an sayakoonu minkum marda waakharoona yadriboona fee alardi yabtaghoona min fadli Allahi waakharoona yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi faiqraoo ma tayassara minhu waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waaqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan wama tuqaddimoo lianfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu AAinda Allahi huwa khayran waaAAthama ajran waistaghfiroo Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

74.tr: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
Arise and warn
And your Lord glorify
And your clothing purify
And uncleanliness avoid
And do not confer favor to acquire more
But for your Lord be patient.
And when the trumpet is blown,
That Day will be a difficult day
For the disbelievers - not easy.
Leave Me with the one I created alone
And to whom I granted extensive wealth
And children present [with him]
And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
Then he desires that I should add more.
No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
I will cover him with arduous torment.
Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
Then he considered [again];
Then he frowned and scowled;
Then he turned back and was arrogant

74.t: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
74.c: فقال إن هذا إلا سحر يؤثر
74.tr: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
74.tl: Faqala in hatha illa sihrun yutharu

74.tr: This is not but the word of a human being."
I will drive him into Saqar.
And what can make you know what is Saqar?
It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
Blackening the skins.
Over it are nineteen [angels].

74.t: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
74.c: وما جعلنا أصحاب النار إلا ملائكة وما جعلنا عدتهم إلا فتنة للذين كفروا ليستيقن الذين أوتوا الكتاب ويزداد الذين آمنوا إيمانا ولا يرتاب الذين أوتوا الكتاب والمؤمنون وليقول الذين في قلوبهم مرض والكافرون ماذا أراد الله بهذا مثلا كذلك يضل الله من يشاء ويهدي من يشاء وما يعلم جنود ربك إلا هو وما هي إلا ذكرى للبشر
74.tr: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
74.tl: Wama jaAAalna ashaba alnnari illa malaikatan wama jaAAalna AAiddatahum illa fitnatan lillatheena kafaroo liyastayqina allatheena ootoo alkitaba wayazdada allatheena amanoo eemanan wala yartaba allatheena ootoo alkitaba waalmuminoona waliyaqoola allatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalkafiroona matha arada Allahu bihatha mathalan kathalika yudillu Allahu man yashao wayahdee man yashao wama yaAAlamu junooda rabbika illa huwa wama hiya illa thikra lilbashari

74.tr: No! By the moon
And [by] the night when it departs
And [by] the morning when it brightens,
Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
As a warning to humanity -

74.t: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
74.c: لمن شاء منكم أن يتقدم أو يتأخر
74.tr: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
74.tl: Liman shaa minkum an yataqaddama aw yataakhkhara

74.tr: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
Except the companions of the right,
[Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
About the criminals,
[And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
Nor did we used to feed the poor.
And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
Until there came to us the certainty."
So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
As if they were alarmed donkeys
Fleeing from a lion?

74.t: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
74.c: بل يريد كل امرئ منهم أن يؤتى صحفا منشرة
74.tr: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
74.tl: Bal yureedu kullu imriin minhum an yuta suhufan munashsharatan

74.tr: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
Then whoever wills will remember it.

74.t: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
74.c: وما يذكرون إلا أن يشاء الله هو أهل التقوى وأهل المغفرة
74.tr: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
74.tl: Wama yathkuroona illa an yashaa Allahu huwa ahlu alttaqwa waahlu almaghfirati

75.tr: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

75.t: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
75.c: بلى قادرين على أن نسوي بنانه
75.tr: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
75.tl: Bala qadireena AAala an nusawwiya bananahu

75.tr: But man desires to continue in sin.
He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
So when vision is dazzled
And the moon darkens
And the sun and the moon are joined,
Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
No! There is no refuge.
To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

75.t: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
75.c: ينبأ الإنسان يومئذ بما قدم وأخر
75.tr: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
75.tl: Yunabbao alinsanu yawmaithin bima qaddama waakhkhara

75.tr: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
Even if he presents his excuses.

75.t: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
75.c: لا تحرك به لسانك لتعجل به
75.tr: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.
75.tl: La tuharrik bihi lisanaka litaAAjala bihi

75.tr: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
No! But you love the immediate
And leave the Hereafter.
[Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
Looking at their Lord.
And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
And the leg is wound about the leg,
To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.
But [instead], he denied and turned away.
And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
Woe to you, and woe!
Then woe to you, and woe!
Does man think that he will be left neglected?

75.t: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
75.c: ألم يك نطفة من مني يمنى
75.tr: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
75.tl: Alam yaku nutfatan min manayyin yumna

75.tr: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

75.t: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
75.c: أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى
75.tr: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
75.tl: Alaysa thalika biqadirin AAala an yuhyiya almawta

76.t: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
76.c: هل أتى على الإنسان حين من الدهر لم يكن شيئا مذكورا
76.tr: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
76.tl: Hal ata AAala alinsani heenun mina alddahri lam yakun shayan mathkooran

76.t: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
76.c: إنا خلقنا الإنسان من نطفة أمشاج نبتليه فجعلناه سميعا بصيرا
76.tr: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
76.tl: Inna khalaqna alinsana min nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi fajaAAalnahu sameeAAan baseeran

76.t: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
76.c: إنا هديناه السبيل إما شاكرا وإما كفورا
76.tr: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
76.tl: Inna hadaynahu alssabeela imma shakiran waimma kafooran

76.t: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
76.c: إنا أعتدنا للكافرين سلاسل وأغلالا وسعيرا
76.tr: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
76.tl: Inna aAAtadna lilkafireena salasila waaghlalan wasaAAeeran

76.t: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
76.c: إن الأبرار يشربون من كأس كان مزاجها كافورا
76.tr: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,
76.tl: Inna alabrara yashraboona min kasin kana mizajuha kafooran

76.t: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
76.c: عينا يشرب بها عباد الله يفجرونها تفجيرا
76.tr: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
76.tl: AAaynan yashrabu biha AAibadu Allahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran

76.t: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
76.c: يوفون بالنذر ويخافون يوما كان شره مستطيرا
76.tr: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
76.tl: Yoofoona bialnnathri wayakhafoona yawman kana sharruhu mustateeran

76.t: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
76.c: ويطعمون الطعام على حبه مسكينا ويتيما وأسيرا
76.tr: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
76.tl: WayutAAimona alttaAAama AAala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseeran

76.t: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
76.c: إنما نطعمكم لوجه الله لا نريد منكم جزاء ولا شكورا
76.tr: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
76.tl: Innama nutAAimukum liwajhi Allahi la nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukooran

76.t: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
76.c: إنا نخاف من ربنا يوما عبوسا قمطريرا
76.tr: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
76.tl: Inna nakhafu min rabbina yawman AAaboosan qamtareeran

76.t: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
76.c: فوقاهم الله شر ذلك اليوم ولقاهم نضرة وسرورا
76.tr: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
76.tl: Fawaqahumu Allahu sharra thalika alyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasurooran

76.t: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
76.c: وجزاهم بما صبروا جنة وحريرا
76.tr: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
76.tl: Wajazahum bima sabaroo jannatan wahareeran

76.t: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
76.c: متكئين فيها على الأرائك لا يرون فيها شمسا ولا زمهريرا
76.tr: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
76.tl: Muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki la yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareeran

76.t: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
76.c: ودانية عليهم ظلالها وذللت قطوفها تذليلا
76.tr: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
76.tl: Wadaniyatan AAalayhim thilaluha wathullilat qutoofuha tathleelan

76.t: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
76.c: ويطاف عليهم بآنية من فضة وأكواب كانت قواريرا
76.tr: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
76.tl: Wayutafu AAalayhim bianiyatin min fiddatin waakwabin kanat qawareera

76.t: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
76.c: قوارير من فضة قدروها تقديرا
76.tr: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
76.tl: Qawareera min fiddatin qaddarooha taqdeeran

76.t: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
76.c: ويسقون فيها كأسا كان مزاجها زنجبيلا
76.tr: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
76.tl: Wayusqawna feeha kasan kana mizajuha zanjabeelan

76.t: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
76.c: عينا فيها تسمى سلسبيلا
76.tr: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
76.tl: AAaynan feeha tusamma salsabeelan

76.t: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
76.c: ويطوف عليهم ولدان مخلدون إذا رأيتهم حسبتهم لؤلؤا منثورا
76.tr: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
76.tl: Wayatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum luluan manthooran

76.t: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
76.c: وإذا رأيت ثم رأيت نعيما وملكا كبيرا
76.tr: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
76.tl: Waitha raayta thamma raayta naAAeeman wamulkan kabeeran

76.t: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
76.c: عاليهم ثياب سندس خضر وإستبرق وحلوا أساور من فضة وسقاهم ربهم شرابا طهورا
76.tr: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
76.tl: AAaliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun waistabraqun wahulloo asawira min fiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran

76.t: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
76.c: إن هذا كان لكم جزاء وكان سعيكم مشكورا
76.tr: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
76.tl: Inna hatha kana lakum jazaan wakana saAAyukum mashkooran

76.t: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
76.c: إنا نحن نزلنا عليك القرآن تنزيلا
76.tr: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
76.tl: Inna nahnu nazzalna AAalayka alqurana tanzeelan

76.t: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
76.c: فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تطع منهم آثما أو كفورا
76.tr: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
76.tl: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala tutiAA minhum athiman aw kafooran

76.t: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
76.c: واذكر اسم ربك بكرة وأصيلا
76.tr: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
76.tl: Waothkuri isma rabbika bukratan waaseelan

76.t: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
76.c: ومن الليل فاسجد له وسبحه ليلا طويلا
76.tr: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
76.tl: Wamina allayli faosjud lahu wasabbihhu laylan taweelan

76.t: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
76.c: إن هؤلاء يحبون العاجلة ويذرون وراءهم يوما ثقيلا
76.tr: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
76.tl: Inna haolai yuhibboona alAAajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawman thaqeelan

76.t: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
76.c: نحن خلقناهم وشددنا أسرهم وإذا شئنا بدلنا أمثالهم تبديلا
76.tr: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
76.tl: Nahnu khalaqnahum washadadna asrahum waitha shina baddalna amthalahum tabdeelan

76.t: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
76.c: إن هذه تذكرة فمن شاء اتخذ إلى ربه سبيلا
76.tr: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
76.tl: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan

76.t: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
76.c: وما تشاءون إلا أن يشاء الله إن الله كان عليما حكيما
76.tr: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
76.tl: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman

76.t: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
76.c: يدخل من يشاء في رحمته والظالمين أعد لهم عذابا أليما
76.tr: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
76.tl: Yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimeena aAAadda lahum AAathaban aleeman

77.tr: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
And the winds that blow violently
And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
And those [angels] who bring criterion
And those [angels] who deliver a message
As justification or warning,
Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
So when the stars are obliterated
And when the heaven is opened
And when the mountains are blown away
And when the messengers' time has come...
For what Day was it postponed?
For the Day of Judgement.
And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Did We not destroy the former peoples?
Then We will follow them with the later ones.
Thus do We deal with the criminals.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
And We placed it in a firm lodging
For a known extent.
And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Have We not made the earth a container
Of the living and the dead?

77.t: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا
77.c: وجعلنا فيها رواسي شامخات وأسقيناكم ماء فراتا
77.tr: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
77.tl: WajaAAalna feeha rawasiya shamikhatin waasqaynakum maan furatan

77.tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

77.t: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
77.c: انطلقوا إلى ما كنتم به تكذبون
77.tr: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
77.tl: Intaliqoo ila ma kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

77.t: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍ
77.c: انطلقوا إلى ظل ذي ثلاث شعب
77.tr: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
77.tl: Intaliqoo ila thillin thee thalathi shuAAabin

77.t: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
77.c: لا ظليل ولا يغني من اللهب
77.tr: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
77.tl: La thaleelin wala yughnee mina allahabi

77.tr: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
This is a Day they will not speak,
Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
And fruits from whatever they desire,

77.t: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
77.c: كلوا واشربوا هنيئا بما كنتم تعملون
77.tr: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
77.tl: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona

77.tr: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
[O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

77.t: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
77.c: وإذا قيل لهم اركعوا لا يركعون
77.tr: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
77.tl: Waitha qeela lahumu irkaAAoo la yarkaAAoona

77.tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?

78.tr: About what are they asking one another?
About the great news -
That over which they are in disagreement.
No! They are going to know.
Then, no! They are going to know.
Have We not made the earth a resting place?
And the mountains as stakes?
And We created you in pairs
And made your sleep [a means for] rest
And made the night as clothing
And made the day for livelihood
And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
And made [therein] a burning lamp
And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
And gardens of entwined growth.
Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

78.t: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
78.c: يوم ينفخ في الصور فتأتون أفواجا
78.tr: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
78.tl: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori fatatoona afwajan

78.tr: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
For the transgressors, a place of return,
In which they will remain for ages [unending].

78.t: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
78.c: لا يذوقون فيها بردا ولا شرابا
78.tr: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
78.tl: La yathooqoona feeha bardan wala sharaban

78.tr: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
An appropriate recompense.
Indeed, they were not expecting an account
And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
But all things We have enumerated in writing.
"So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
Gardens and grapevines
And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
And a full cup.

78.t: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
78.c: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا كذابا
78.tr: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
78.tl: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala kiththaban

78.tr: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,

78.t: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
78.c: رب السماوات والأرض وما بينهما الرحمن لا يملكون منه خطابا
78.tr: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
78.tl: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alrrahmani la yamlikoona minhu khitaban

78.t: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
78.c: يوم يقوم الروح والملائكة صفا لا يتكلمون إلا من أذن له الرحمن وقال صوابا
78.tr: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
78.tl: Yawma yaqoomu alrroohu waalmalaikatu saffan la yatakallamoona illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waqala sawaban

78.t: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
78.c: ذلك اليوم الحق فمن شاء اتخذ إلى ربه مآبا
78.tr: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
78.tl: Thalika alyawmu alhaqqu faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi maaban

78.t: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
78.c: إنا أنذرناكم عذابا قريبا يوم ينظر المرء ما قدمت يداه ويقول الكافر يا ليتني كنت ترابا
78.tr: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
78.tl: Inna antharnakum AAathaban qareeban yawma yanthuru almaro ma qaddamat yadahu wayaqoolu alkafiru ya laytanee kuntu turaban

79.tr: By those [angels] who extract with violence
And [by] those who remove with ease
And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
And those who race each other in a race
And those who arrange [each] matter,
On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
There will follow it the subsequent [one].
Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
Their eyes humbled.
They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
Even if we should be decayed bones?
They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
Indeed, it will be but one shout,
And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

79.t: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
79.c: إذ ناداه ربه بالواد المقدس طوى
79.tr: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
79.tl: Ith nadahu rabbuhu bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan

79.tr: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

79.t: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
79.c: فقل هل لك إلى أن تزكى
79.tr: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
79.tl: Faqul hal laka ila an tazakka

79.tr: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
And he showed him the greatest sign,
But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.
Then he turned his back, striving.
And he gathered [his people] and called out
And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].

79.t: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
79.c: إن في ذلك لعبرة لمن يخشى
79.tr: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].
79.tl: Inna fee thalika laAAibratan liman yakhsha

79.t: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
79.c: أأنتم أشد خلقا أم السماء بناها
79.tr: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
79.tl: Aantum ashaddu khalqan ami alssamao banaha

79.tr: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
And after that He spread the earth.
He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
And the mountains He set firmly
As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
So as for he who transgressed
And preferred the life of the world,
Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

79.t: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
79.c: وأما من خاف مقام ربه ونهى النفس عن الهوى
79.tr: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
79.tl: Waama man khafa maqama rabbihi wanaha alnnafsa AAani alhawa

79.tr: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
To your Lord is its finality.
You are only a warner for those who fear it.

79.t: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
79.c: كأنهم يوم يرونها لم يلبثوا إلا عشية أو ضحاها
79.tr: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
79.tl: Kaannahum yawma yarawnaha lam yalbathoo illa AAashiyyatan aw duhaha

80.tr: The Prophet frowned and turned away
Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
As for he who thinks himself without need,
To him you give attention.
And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
While he fears [Allah],
From him you are distracted.
No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
So whoever wills may remember it.
[It is recorded] in honored sheets,
Exalted and purified,
[Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
Noble and dutiful.
Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.
From what substance did He create him?
From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
Then He eased the way for him;
Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
Then let mankind look at his food -
How We poured down water in torrents,
Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
And caused to grow within it grain
And grapes and herbage
And olive and palm trees
And gardens of dense shrubbery
And fruit and grass -
[As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
But when there comes the Deafening Blast
On the Day a man will flee from his brother
And his mother and his father
And his wife and his children,

80.t: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
80.c: لكل امرئ منهم يومئذ شأن يغنيه
80.tr: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
80.tl: Likulli imriin minhum yawmaithin shanun yughneehi

80.tr: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
Blackness will cover them.
Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.

81.tr: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
And when the stars fall, dispersing,
And when the mountains are removed
And when full-term she-camels are neglected
And when the wild beasts are gathered
And when the seas are filled with flame
And when the souls are paired
And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
For what sin she was killed
And when the pages are made public
And when the sky is stripped away
And when Hellfire is set ablaze
And when Paradise is brought near,
A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
So I swear by the retreating stars -
Those that run [their courses] and disappear -
And by the night as it closes in
And by the dawn when it breathes
[That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger

81.t: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
81.c: ذي قوة عند ذي العرش مكين
81.tr: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
81.tl: Thee quwwatin AAinda thee alAAarshi makeenin

81.tr: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
And your companion is not [at all] mad.
And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.
And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
So where are you going?
It is not except a reminder to the worlds
For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

81.t: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
81.c: وما تشاءون إلا أن يشاء الله رب العالمين
81.tr: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
81.tl: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu rabbu alAAalameena

82.tr: And when the stars fall, scattering,
And when the seas are erupted
And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

82.t: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
82.c: يا أيها الإنسان ما غرك بربك الكريم
82.tr: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
82.tl: Ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareemi

82.tr: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

82.t: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
82.c: في أي صورة ما شاء ركبك
82.tr: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
82.tl: Fee ayyi sooratin ma shaa rakkabaka

82.tr: No! But you deny the Recompense.
And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
And never therefrom will they be absent.
And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

82.t: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
82.c: ثم ما أدراك ما يوم الدين
82.tr: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
82.tl: Thumma ma adraka ma yawmu alddeeni

82.t: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
82.c: يوم لا تملك نفس لنفس شيئا والأمر يومئذ لله
82.tr: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
82.tl: Yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan waalamru yawmaithin lillahi

83.tr: Woe to those who give less [than due],

83.t: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
83.c: الذين إذا اكتالوا على الناس يستوفون
83.tr: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
83.tl: Allatheena itha iktaloo AAala alnnasi yastawfoona

83.tr: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
Do they not think that they will be resurrected
For a tremendous Day -
The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

83.t: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
83.c: كلا إن كتاب الفجار لفي سجين
83.tr: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
83.tl: Kalla inna kitaba alfujjari lafee sijjeenin

83.tr: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
Who deny the Day of Recompense.

83.t: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
83.c: وما يكذب به إلا كل معتد أثيم
83.tr: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
83.tl: Wama yukaththibu bihi illa kullu muAAtadin atheemin

83.t: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
83.c: إذا تتلى عليه آياتنا قال أساطير الأولين
83.tr: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
83.tl: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena

83.t: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
83.c: كلا بل ران على قلوبهم ما كانوا يكسبون
83.tr: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
83.tl: Kalla bal rana AAala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona

83.t: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
83.c: كلا إنهم عن ربهم يومئذ لمحجوبون
83.tr: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
83.tl: Kalla innahum AAan rabbihim yawmaithin lamahjooboona

83.tr: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

83.t: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
83.c: ثم يقال هذا الذي كنتم به تكذبون
83.tr: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
83.tl: Thumma yuqalu hatha allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

83.t: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
83.c: كلا إن كتاب الأبرار لفي عليين
83.tr: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
83.tl: Kalla inna kitaba alabrari lafee AAilliyyeena

83.tr: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
On adorned couches, observing.
You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

83.t: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
83.c: ختامه مسك وفي ذلك فليتنافس المتنافسون
83.tr: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
83.tl: Khitamuhu miskun wafee thalika falyatanafasi almutanafisoona

83.tr: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.

83.t: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
83.c: إن الذين أجرموا كانوا من الذين آمنوا يضحكون
83.tr: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
83.tl: Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoo mina allatheena amanoo yadhakoona

83.tr: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

83.t: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
83.c: وإذا انقلبوا إلى أهلهم انقلبوا فكهين
83.tr: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
83.tl: Waitha inqalaboo ila ahlihimu inqalaboo fakiheena

83.t: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
83.c: وإذا رأوهم قالوا إن هؤلاء لضالون
83.tr: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
83.tl: Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona

83.tr: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

83.t: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
83.c: فاليوم الذين آمنوا من الكفار يضحكون
83.tr: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
83.tl: Faalyawma allatheena amanoo mina alkuffari yadhakoona

83.tr: On adorned couches, observing.

83.t: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
83.c: هل ثوب الكفار ما كانوا يفعلون
83.tr: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
83.tl: Hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanoo yafAAaloona

84.tr: When the sky has split [open]
And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
And when the earth has been extended
And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -

84.t: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
84.c: يا أيها الإنسان إنك كادح إلى ربك كدحا فملاقيه
84.tr: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
84.tl: Ya ayyuha alinsanu innaka kadihun ila rabbika kadhan famulaqeehi

84.tr: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
He will be judged with an easy account
And return to his people in happiness.

84.t: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
84.c: وأما من أوتي كتابه وراء ظهره
84.tr: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
84.tl: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu waraa thahrihi

84.tr: He will cry out for destruction
And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].

84.t: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
84.c: بلى إن ربه كان به بصيرا
84.tr: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
84.tl: Bala inna rabbahu kana bihi baseeran

84.tr: So I swear by the twilight glow
And [by] the night and what it envelops
And [by] the moon when it becomes full
[That] you will surely experience state after state.
So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

84.t: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
84.c: وإذا قرئ عليهم القرآن لا يسجدون
84.tr: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
84.tl: Waitha quria AAalayhimu alquranu la yasjudoona

84.tr: But those who have disbelieved deny,
And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

84.t: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
84.c: إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم أجر غير ممنون
84.tr: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
84.tl: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

85.tr: By the sky containing great stars
And [by] the promised Day
And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
Cursed were the companions of the trench
[Containing] the fire full of fuel,
When they were sitting near it

85.t: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
85.c: وهم على ما يفعلون بالمؤمنين شهود
85.tr: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
85.tl: Wahum AAala ma yafAAaloona bialmumineena shuhoodun

85.t: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
85.c: وما نقموا منهم إلا أن يؤمنوا بالله العزيز الحميد
85.tr: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
85.tl: Wama naqamoo minhum illa an yuminoo biAllahi alAAazeezi alhameedi

85.t: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
85.c: الذي له ملك السماوات والأرض والله على كل شيء شهيد
85.tr: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
85.tl: Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waAllahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun

85.t: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
85.c: إن الذين فتنوا المؤمنين والمؤمنات ثم لم يتوبوا فلهم عذاب جهنم ولهم عذاب الحريق
85.tr: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
85.tl: Inna allatheena fatanoo almumineena waalmuminati thumma lam yatooboo falahum AAathabu jahannama walahum AAathabu alhareeqi

85.t: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
85.c: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار ذلك الفوز الكبير
85.tr: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
85.tl: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu thalika alfawzu alkabeeru

85.tr: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
Honorable Owner of the Throne,
Effecter of what He intends.
Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
[Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?
But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
While Allah encompasses them from behind.
But this is an honored Qur'an
[Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.

86.tr: By the sky and the night comer -
And what can make you know what is the night comer?

86.t: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
86.c: إن كل نفس لما عليها حافظ
86.tr: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
86.tl: In kullu nafsin lamma AAalayha hafithun

86.tr: So let man observe from what he was created.
He was created from a fluid, ejected,
Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.
The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

86.t: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
86.c: فما له من قوة ولا ناصر
86.tr: Then man will have no power or any helper.
86.tl: Fama lahu min quwwatin wala nasirin

86.tr: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
Indeed, they are planning a plan,
But I am planning a plan.
So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.

87.tr: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
And who brings out the pasture
We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,

87.t: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
87.c: إلا ما شاء الله إنه يعلم الجهر وما يخفى
87.tr: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
87.tl: Illa ma shaa Allahu innahu yaAAlamu aljahra wama yakhfa

87.tr: And We will ease you toward ease.
So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
But the wretched one will avoid it -
[He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

87.t: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
87.c: ثم لا يموت فيها ولا يحيى
87.tl: Thumma la yamootu feeha wala yahya

87.tr: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
But you prefer the worldly life,
While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

88.tr: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
[Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
Working [hard] and exhausted.
They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

88.t: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ
88.c: ليس لهم طعام إلا من ضريع
88.tr: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
88.tl: Laysa lahum taAAamun illa min dareeAAin

88.t: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ
88.c: لا يسمن ولا يغني من جوع
88.tr: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
88.tl: La yusminu wala yughnee min jooAAin

88.tr: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
With their effort [they are] satisfied
In an elevated garden,
Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
Within it is a flowing spring.
Within it are couches raised high
And cups put in place
And cushions lined up
And carpets spread around.

88.t: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
88.c: أفلا ينظرون إلى الإبل كيف خلقت
88.tr: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
88.tl: Afala yanthuroona ila alibili kayfa khuliqat

88.tr: And at the sky - how it is raised?
And at the mountains - how they are erected?
And at the earth - how it is spread out?
So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
You are not over them a controller.
However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
Indeed, to Us is their return.
Then indeed, upon Us is their account.

89.tr: By the dawn
And [by] ten nights
And [by] the even [number] and the odd
And [by] the night when it passes,

89.t: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
89.c: هل في ذلك قسم لذي حجر
89.tr: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
89.tl: Hal fee thalika qasamun lithee hijrin

89.t: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
89.c: ألم تر كيف فعل ربك بعاد
89.tr: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
89.tl: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biAAadin

89.tr: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,

89.t: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
89.c: التي لم يخلق مثلها في البلاد
89.tr: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
89.tl: Allatee lam yukhlaq mithluha fee albiladi

89.tr: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -
[All of] whom oppressed within the lands
And increased therein the corruption.
So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

89.t: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
89.c: فأما الإنسان إذا ما ابتلاه ربه فأكرمه ونعمه فيقول ربي أكرمن
89.tr: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
89.tl: Faamma alinsanu itha ma ibtalahu rabbuhu faakramahu wanaAAAAamahu fayaqoolu rabbee akramani

89.t: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
89.c: وأما إذا ما ابتلاه فقدر عليه رزقه فيقول ربي أهانن
89.tr: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
89.tl: Waamma itha ma ibtalahu faqadara AAalayhi rizqahu fayaqoolu rabbee ahanani

89.tr: No! But you do not honor the orphan
And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
And you love wealth with immense love.

89.t: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
89.c: كلا إذا دكت الأرض دكا دكا
89.tr: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -
89.tl: Kalla itha dukkati alardu dakkan dakkan

89.tr: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,

89.t: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
89.c: وجيء يومئذ بجهنم يومئذ يتذكر الإنسان وأنى له الذكرى
89.tr: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
89.tl: Wajeea yawmaithin bijahannama yawmaithin yatathakkaru alinsanu waanna lahu alththikra

89.tr: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
[To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
And enter among My [righteous] servants
And enter My Paradise."

90.tr: I swear by this city, Makkah -
And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
We have certainly created man into hardship.

90.t: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
90.c: أيحسب أن لن يقدر عليه أحد
90.tr: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
90.tl: Ayahsabu an lan yaqdira AAalayhi ahadun

90.tr: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
Does he think that no one has seen him?
Have We not made for him two eyes?
And a tongue and two lips?
And have shown him the two ways?
But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
It is the freeing of a slave

90.t: أَوْ إِطْعَـٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ
90.c: أو إطعام في يوم ذي مسغبة
90.tr: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
90.tl: Aw itAAamun fee yawmin thee masghabatin

90.tr: An orphan of near relationship
Or a needy person in misery

90.t: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
90.c: ثم كان من الذين آمنوا وتواصوا بالصبر وتواصوا بالمرحمة
90.tr: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
90.tl: Thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati

90.tr: Those are the companions of the right.

90.t: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
90.c: والذين كفروا بآياتنا هم أصحاب المشأمة
90.tr: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
90.tl: Waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati

90.tr: Over them will be fire closed in.

91.tr: By the sun and its brightness
And [by] the moon when it follows it
And [by] the day when it displays it
And [by] the night when it covers it
And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
And [by] the earth and He who spread it
And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
He has succeeded who purifies it,
And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
When the most wretched of them was sent forth.

91.t: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
91.c: فقال لهم رسول الله ناقة الله وسقياها
91.tr: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
91.tl: Faqala lahum rasoolu Allahi naqata Allahi wasuqyaha

91.t: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
91.c: فكذبوه فعقروها فدمدم عليهم ربهم بذنبهم فسواها
91.tr: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
91.tl: Fakaththaboohu faAAaqarooha fadamdama AAalayhim rabbuhum bithanbihim fasawwaha

91.tr: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.

92.tr: By the night when it covers
And [by] the day when it appears
And [by] He who created the male and female,
Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
As for he who gives and fears Allah
And believes in the best [reward],
We will ease him toward ease.
But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
And denies the best [reward],
We will ease him toward difficulty.

92.t: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
92.c: وما يغني عنه ماله إذا تردى
92.tr: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
92.tl: Wama yughnee AAanhu maluhu itha taradda

92.tr: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
Who had denied and turned away.
But the righteous one will avoid it -
[He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

92.t: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
92.c: وما لأحد عنده من نعمة تجزى
92.tr: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
92.tl: Wama liahadin AAindahu min niAAmatin tujza

92.tr: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
And he is going to be satisfied.

93.tr: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
And He found you lost and guided [you],
And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].

94.tr: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
And We removed from you your burden
Which had weighed upon your back
And raised high for you your repute.
For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

95.tr: By the fig and the olive

95.t: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
95.c: لقد خلقنا الإنسان في أحسن تقويم
95.tr: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
95.tl: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee ahsani taqweemin

95.tr: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,

95.t: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
95.c: إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات فلهم أجر غير ممنون
95.tr: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
95.tl: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati falahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

95.tr: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
Is not Allah the most just of judges?

96.tr: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
Created man from a clinging substance.
Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
Taught man that which he knew not.
Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
Have you seen the one who forbids
Have you seen if he is upon guidance
Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
Does he not know that Allah sees?

96.t: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
96.c: كلا لئن لم ينته لنسفعا بالناصية
96.tr: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
96.tl: Kalla lain lam yantahi lanasfaAAan bialnnasiyati

96.tr: Then let him call his associates;
We will call the angels of Hell.
No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].

97.tr: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

97.t: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
97.c: ليلة القدر خير من ألف شهر
97.tr: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
97.tl: Laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahrin

97.t: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
97.c: تنزل الملائكة والروح فيها بإذن ربهم من كل أمر
97.tr: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
97.tl: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin

97.tr: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

98.t: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
98.c: لم يكن الذين كفروا من أهل الكتاب والمشركين منفكين حتى تأتيهم البينة
98.tr: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -
98.tl: Lam yakuni allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena munfakkeena hatta tatiyahumu albayyinatu

98.t: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
98.c: رسول من الله يتلو صحفا مطهرة
98.tr: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures
98.tl: Rasoolun mina Allahi yatloo suhufan mutahharatan

98.t: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
98.c: وما تفرق الذين أوتوا الكتاب إلا من بعد ما جاءتهم البينة
98.tr: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
98.tl: Wama tafarraqa allatheena ootoo alkitaba illa min baAAdi ma jaathumu albayyinatu

98.t: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
98.c: وما أمروا إلا ليعبدوا الله مخلصين له الدين حنفاء ويقيموا الصلاة ويؤتوا الزكاة وذلك دين القيمة
98.tr: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
98.tl: Wama omiroo illa liyaAAbudoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena hunafaa wayuqeemoo alssalata wayutoo alzzakata wathalika deenu alqayyimati

98.t: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
98.c: إن الذين كفروا من أهل الكتاب والمشركين في نار جهنم خالدين فيها أولئك هم شر البرية
98.tr: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
98.tl: Inna allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena fee nari jahannama khalideena feeha olaika hum sharru albariyyati

98.t: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
98.c: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات أولئك هم خير البرية
98.tr: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
98.tl: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika hum khayru albariyyati

98.t: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
98.c: جزاؤهم عند ربهم جنات عدن تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه ذلك لمن خشي ربه
98.tr: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
98.tl: Jazaohum AAinda rabbihim jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu thalika liman khashiya rabbahu

99.tr: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
And the earth discharges its burdens
And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
That Day, it will report its news
Because your Lord has commanded it.

99.t: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
99.c: يومئذ يصدر الناس أشتاتا ليروا أعمالهم
99.tr: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
99.tl: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum

99.t: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
99.c: فمن يعمل مثقال ذرة خيرا يره
99.tr: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
99.tl: Faman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin khayran yarahu

99.t: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
99.c: ومن يعمل مثقال ذرة شرا يره
99.tr: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
99.tl: Waman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin sharran yarahu

100.tr: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
And indeed, he is to that a witness.
And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.

100.t: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
100.c: أفلا يعلم إذا بعثر ما في القبور
100.tr: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
100.tl: Afala yaAAlamu itha buAAthira ma fee alquboori

100.tr: And that within the breasts is obtained,
Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.

101.tr: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
He will be in a pleasant life.
But as for one whose scales are light,
His refuge will be an abyss.
And what can make you know what that is?
It is a Fire, intensely hot.

102.tr: No! You are going to know.
Then no! You are going to know.
No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
You will surely see the Hellfire.
Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.

103.t: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
103.c: إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات وتواصوا بالحق وتواصوا بالصبر
103.tr: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
103.tl: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati watawasaw bialhaqqi watawasaw bialssabri

104.tr: Woe to every scorner and mocker
Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
Which mounts directed at the hearts.
Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them

105.t: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
105.c: ألم تر كيف فعل ربك بأصحاب الفيل
105.tr: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
105.tl: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biashabi alfeeli

105.tr: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
And He sent against them birds in flocks,
Striking them with stones of hard clay,
And He made them like eaten straw.

106.tr: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
Let them worship the Lord of this House,

106.t: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
106.c: الذي أطعمهم من جوع وآمنهم من خوف
106.tr: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
106.tl: Allathee atAAamahum min jooAAin waamanahum min khawfin

107.tr: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
For that is the one who drives away the orphan
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer -
Those who make show [of their deeds]

108.tr: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.

109.tr: I do not worship what you worship.
Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."

110.tr: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,

110.t: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
110.c: ورأيت الناس يدخلون في دين الله أفواجا
110.tr: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
110.tl: Waraayta alnnasa yadkhuloona fee deeni Allahi afwajan

110.t: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
110.c: فسبح بحمد ربك واستغفره إنه كان توابا
110.tr: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
110.tl: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika waistaghfirhu innahu kana tawwaban

111.tr: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.

111.t: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
111.c: ما أغنى عنه ماله وما كسب
111.tr: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
111.tl: Ma aghna AAanhu maluhu wama kasaba

111.tr: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.

112.tr: He neither begets nor is born,
Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

113.tr: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
From the evil of that which He created
And from the evil of darkness when it settles
And from the evil of the blowers in knots
And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

114.tr: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
From among the jinn and mankind."
